edges.reason: _transfer invokes swapBack which performs external router swaps and ETH transfers while token accounting is still in progress
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when LP burn conditions are satisfied
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert contract tokens into ETH
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add the liquidity portion with ETH
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates the mapping write to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair
constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction which carries the onlyOwner modifier check
constructor calls excludeFromFees which carries the onlyOwner modifier check
constructor registers the created Uniswap pair as an AMM pair
swapTokensForEth performs the external router fee-on-transfer swap
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet through an unchecked low-level call
swapBack forwards the remaining ETH balance to marketingWallet through a low-level call
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync()
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync()
devWallet low-level value call can reenter _transfer paths that mutate balances and fee pots
marketingWallet low-level value call can reenter _transfer while swapping flag semantics are incomplete
router swap moves tokens and re-enters the overridden _transfer before state is settled
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, making the deployer the sole initial holder
enableTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp, letting the owner influence burn scheduling
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp, making burn gating miner-influenced
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens compares block.timestamp against cooldown bounds
_transfer keys the per-block anti-bot mapping on tx.origin, which is bypassable by intermediate contracts
_transfer gates automatic LP burning on block.timestamp relative to lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline
from address flows into the overridden transfer logic
to address flows into the overridden transfer logic
amount flows into limit checks and fee computation
tokenAmount flows into the router swap call
tokenAmount flows into addLiquidityETH
ethAmount flows into the payable addLiquidityETH call
percent flows into the manual burn amount computation
newMarketingWallet is written to marketingWallet
newWallet is written to devWallet
_percent is written to percentForLPBurn
_marketingFee feeds buyMarketingFee and buyTotalFees
newAmount is validated and written to swapTokensAtAmount
account is written into the _isExcludedFromFees mapping
pair is validated against uniswapV2Pair and passed to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair
contractTokenBalance drives the canSwap decision
canSwap controls entry into swapBack
takeFee controls whether fees are deducted
fees is deducted from the transfer amount in _transfer
contractBalance bounds the amount swapped in swapBack
totalTokensToSwap is used as the denominator for ETH distribution
liquidityTokens determines the token side of addLiquidity
amountToSwapForETH is passed to swapTokensForEth
ethBalance is split into marketing, dev and liquidity shares
ethForMarketing influences the final balance sweep to marketingWallet
ethForDev is the value forwarded to devWallet via low-level call
ethForLiquidity is the ETH value supplied to addLiquidity
path is passed to the router swap call
liquidityPairBalance is scaled by percentForLPBurn
amountToBurn is transferred from the pair to the dead address
liquidityPairBalance is scaled by the percent argument
amountToBurn is transferred from the pair to the dead address
fees is produced by mul/div arithmetic over total fee percentages
amount is decremented by the collected fees before the final transfer
tradingActive gates non-excluded transfers
swapEnabled gates the automatic swapBack trigger

maxTransactionAmount bounds buy and sell amounts
maxWallet bounds post-transfer recipient balance

_isExcludedFromFees bypasses fee collection and trading gating
limitsInEffect enables the anti-whale block
transferDelayEnabled enables the tx.origin based purchase delay
_holderLastTransferTimestamp stores and reads per-origin block numbers

sellTotalFees is applied to sell transfers

sellLiquidityFee splits the sell fee pot

uniswapV2Router is the swap target in swapTokensForEth

uniswapV2Pair is the source of manually burned tokens

normalization_plan.reason: from is only meaningful as an input to the overridden _transfer and should be folded into it
to is only meaningful as an input to _transfer limit and fee logic
amount feeds _transfer limit checks, fee math and the final balance update
tokenAmount is only used by swapTokensForEth as the swap input
tokenAmount is only used by addLiquidity as the token input
ethAmount is only used by addLiquidity as the payable value
percent is only used by manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens to scale the burn
newMarketingWallet is only written into the marketingWallet state by the setter
newWallet is only written into the devWallet state by the setter
_percent is only written into percentForLPBurn by setAutoLPBurnSettings
_marketingFee is only aggregated into buy fee state variables
newAmount is bounded and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount inside the update function
account is only used to write the fee exclusion mapping and emit an event
pair is validated against uniswapV2Pair then forwarded to the AMM pair setter
contractTokenBalance is a temporary read used only to compute canSwap inside _transfer
canSwap is a pure boolean gate local to _transfer
takeFee is a local decision flag consumed by the fee block in _transfer
fees is the product of the mul/div arithmetic that computes the transfer fee
contractBalance is a swapBack-local snapshot of the contract token balance
totalTokensToSwap is a swapBack-local denominator for ETH distribution
liquidityTokens is a swapBack-local half-split of the liquidity allocation
amountToSwapForETH is computed in swapBack purely to feed swapTokensForEth
ethBalance is a swapBack-local measurement of newly received ETH
ethForMarketing is an intermediate split value used only inside swapBack
ethForDev is the value payload of the low-level call to devWallet
ethForLiquidity is passed directly into addLiquidity from swapBack
path is a swap-route array local to swapTokensForEth
liquidityPairBalance is an auto-burn-local read of the LP pair balance
amountToBurn is the auto-burn-local quantity transferred to the dead address
liquidityPairBalance is a manual-burn-local read of the LP pair balance
amountToBurn is the manual-burn-local quantity transferred to the dead address
